summary: Flagship diagnosis tree: observation, evidence-backed negative, evidence-backed root cause. Probes cover negatives-first substance, fingerprint exact match, the seen-set, the session cap, self-exclusion, an unrelated prompt, a below-threshold near-match, and the tripwire.

workContexts.title: Login 500s after JWT key rotation
workContexts.description: POST /login answers 500 for a tenth of requests after the JWKS cutover

claims.body: POST /login answers 500 for roughly one request in ten after the JWKS cutover
Reverting the edge proxy config does not stop the login 500s
verifyToken rejects tokens minted under the rotated JWKS key because the key cache never refetches

probes.rationale: Negatives are privileged (DESIGN.md 4): the evidence-backed rejected_approach is scanned before the settled positive inside the same context, and negative knowledge cannot anchor a wrong theory.

probes.prompt: why does src/auth/refresh.ts still 500 after the key rotation
probes.rationale: Seen-set dedup: the already-delivered negative is skipped and the next unseen injectable claim (the evidence-backed root cause) arrives instead of a repeat.

probes.prompt: why does src/auth/refresh.ts still 500 after the key rotation
probes.rationale: MAX_HINTS_PER_SESSION is a hard noise budget (DESIGN.md 10 risk 1): at the cap the hook stays silent before the hub is even asked, whatever the prompt matches.

probes.prompt: why does src/auth/refresh.ts still 500 after the key rotation
probes.rationale: Self-exclusion (DESIGN.md 4): the author's own contexts are excluded inside the hub's search WHERE — a developer's own findings are knowledge, never hints.

probes.prompt: checkout cart totals drift when discount codes stack
probes.rationale: No lexical tier matches any teammate context: recency filler must never hint (HINT_ELIGIBLE_TIERS), so an unrelated prompt gets silence, not the freshest context.

probes.prompt: intermittent sign-in trouble after the midnight rollout
probes.rationale: Semantically the same incident as wc_auth, lexically below the provable-match floor: no shared exact target, no shared FTS stem. No hint beats a weak hint (DESIGN.md 4), and the keyless default install has no vector tier to guess with.
Active-teammate file overlap asks and never denies (escalation ladder ceiling): the ask names the teammate and the context id — pointer-class, no claim body crosses.
